profile.headline: Software Engineer @Cigna/Evernorth
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer specializing in backend development, distributed systems, and AI infrastructure.
At Evernorth Health Services, I design and build scalable, cloud-native backend services that power AI-driven workflows in production environments. My experience includes developing microservices in Go and Python, building data ingestion and orchestration pipelines, designing RESTful APIs, and implementing AI rules engines that govern enterprise decision logic.
I lead initiatives focused on AI systems architecture, enabling internal platforms to integrate AI capabilities through standardized APIs and service-based design. My work emphasizes scalability, reliability, performance optimization, and maintainability across distributed environments on AWS.
Previously, I developed automation pipelines and data processing workflows using Python and SQL/SAS, reducing manual reporting effort and improving operational efficiency. This background in data engineering and production systems strengthened my approach to building resilient backend architectures that handle real-world scale.
Core competencies include:
• Backend Engineering (Go, Python, TypeScript, Java)
• Distributed Systems & Microservices Architecture
• REST API Design & Service-Oriented Architecture
• AWS (Lambda, CloudWatch, cloud-native services)
• AI Infrastructure & Rules Engine Design
• Data Pipelines & Workflow Automation
• Production Monitoring, Observability & Incident Resolution
I'm passionate about building scalable backend platforms, designing AI-supporting architectures, and solving complex system design challenges. I enjoy collaborating across engineering and product teams to translate business requirements into reliable, production-grade systems.
Open to connecting with engineers, hiring managers, and technology leaders working on backend engineering, AI systems, and cloud infrastructure.
